canonical_statement: The study aimed to determine whether viable Clostridioides difficile persists in agricultural soil after broiler-manure fertilization and whether genomic relatedness can trace soil and dust isolates to the supplying chicken farm.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: we detected the persistence of viable C. difficile in agricultural soil for several years

canonical_statement: Manure was sampled across two broiler fattening farms and one manure trading cooperative; Farm 1 was sampled three times, Farm 2 once across four stables, and the trader once.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: five samplings were performed on three different sites

canonical_statement: The field experiment applied 12 tons of Farm 1 chicken manure to a 2.1-hectare agricultural field that had not received animal manure for 15 years.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 12 tons of chicken manure from Farm 1 were applied to a 2.1-ha agricultural field

canonical_statement: Dust was collected during manure application at 1.50 m above ground and 20, 50, and 100 m from the tractor; soil was sampled before fertilization, immediately after, and at 2, 4, 7, 10, 14, 19, and 143 weeks.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: at a distance from the tractor of 20, 50 and 100 m respectively

canonical_statement: C. difficile was isolated by selective direct plating where possible and by a seven-day selective enrichment with taurocholic acid followed by ethanol shock when enrichment was required.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: For enrichment cultures, 0.5 ml of suspensions were added to 10 ml brain heart infusion

canonical_statement: Whole-genome sequencing used Illumina NextSeq data processed through EnteroBase; 32 sequences failed EnteroBase quality control and 278 genomes with greater than 99% complete cgMLST profiles were analyzed.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Thirty-two sequences did not pass the quality check in EnteroBase

canonical_statement: Genomic relatedness was evaluated with EnteroBase cgMLST hierarchical clustering and an independent SNP analysis after read mapping to strain R20291 and recombination filtering with ClonalFrameML.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Genomic relatedness was also determined based on SNP analysis

canonical_statement: Antibiotic susceptibility was measured by E-test for vancomycin, metronidazole, moxifloxacin, clindamycin, and tetracycline using published resistance breakpoints.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: MICs were determined for vancomycin, metronidazole, moxifloxacin, clindamycin and tetracycline

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that poultry-manure fertilization can produce long-lasting environmental contamination with viable manure-derived C. difficile.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: viable C. difficile remained detectable in fertilized soil for several years and hence represented a long-lasting contamination

canonical_statement: The authors concluded that manure application can aerosolize viable C. difficile in agricultural dust and may contribute to long-distance dispersal.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: mineral dust from agricultural operations may carry aerosolized, manure-derived C. difficile

canonical_statement: The authors interpreted the close genomic relationship between Farm 1, retail chicken-meat, and human CDI isolates as evidence that this broiler-associated lineage poses a potential zoonotic transmission risk.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Consequently, this C. difficile HC2 clone poses a risk of zoonotic transmission

canonical_statement: The authors stated that the findings support a One Health approach to limiting C. difficile spread among human, livestock, and environmental reservoirs.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: our results corroborate the relevance of a One Health approach

canonical_statement: The authors cautioned that genomic similarity alone does not prove direct transmission between geographically remote sources in the absence of epidemiological evidence.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: pathogen genomic similarity alone does not prove direct transmission between remote places

canonical_statement: Quantitative cultivation from soil and dust was unsuccessful, so the study could not precisely extrapolate survival beyond the observed sampling period.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: precise extrapolation was not possible due to the failure of quantitative cultivation

canonical_statement: The study did not establish whether C. difficile performs substantial metabolic activity or proliferates under ambient soil conditions.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: it is not known if these bacteria are able to perform much metabolic activity or even proliferate under ambient conditions in the soil
